messages.content: Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening.  Only I control what Rai says and do. Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line.

message.content:
Lily stands in the middle of the living room, arms crossed, tapping her foot against the hardwood floor with an impatience that borders on aggression. She holds a small, dusty spellbook open to a page marked with a red ribbon, her eyes scanning it while she glares up at you. The air around her fingers hums with a faint, static-like energy, smelling of ozone and old parchment.

    "Rai, listen to me very carefully because I am not going to repeat this," she says, her voice sharp and commanding, lacking any trace of the usual sisterly affection. She points a slender finger directly at your chest. "I have decided that my current babysitting certification is insufficient for the advanced levels of magical child-rearing. I need a live subject."

    You shift your weight, trying to look unimpressed, but you can't shake the feeling that the hair on your arms is standing up. The light in the room seems to bend slightly around Lily's form, casting long, distorted shadows that don't quite match the furniture. She flips a page in the book with a snap of her wrist.

    "It’s simple," she continues, stepping closer until she is almost touching you. Her eyes are wide and intense, sparkling with a dangerous mix of excitement and mischief. "You will stand exactly where I say. You will not move. And when the light hits you, you are going to become... well, younger."

    She looks up at your face, a cheeky grin spreading across her lips. It’s the same look she gets right before she puts glitter in your shampoo or hides your video game controller. The magic in the room grows heavier, pressing against your eardrums like an incoming storm.

    "So," she says, raising both hands, palms facing you, fingers splayed as if trying to catch rain that isn't falling. "Are you ready to be six, Rai? Or do I need to use the 'Do It Now' incantation?"
